topics.title_zh: 英伟达GTC柏林发布DSX POD将部署压缩至14天，联手Mistral强攻欧洲工业底座
topics.title_en: Nvidia Unveils DSX POD at GTC Berlin Cutting Deployments to 14 Days, Partners with Mistral for Industry
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达在GTC柏林发布基于Vera Rubin架构的DSX POD，将数据中心落地从6个月压缩至14天，并携手Mistral拓展工业仿真生态；然而欧洲严苛的余热回收与碳中和法规正与百兆瓦级算力扩张爆发剧烈摩擦。
topics.summary_en: At GTC Berlin, Nvidia launched DSX POD to compress Vera Rubin data center deployment from six months to 14 days and partnered with Mistral for industrial engineering, while European environmental mandates clash directly with hyperscale energy demands.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 工业主权与算力加速派
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: Mistral AI / Arthur Mensch 与黄仁勋阵营
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Mistral AI / Arthur Mensch & Nvidia Camp
perspective_pro.point_zh: 模块化交付破除了欧洲算力基建的工期死结，配合本土顶级开源模型与物理仿真技术，能让欧洲老牌制造业直接跃迁至工业AI主权新纪元。
perspective_pro.point_en: Modular pods shatter Europe's infrastructure deployment bottlenecks, empowering legacy industries with sovereign open models and real-time physical simulation.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 绿色合规与工业理性派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 欧盟减排监管者与企业集成架构师
perspective_con.point_zh: 算力中心极速落地的代价是撕裂欧洲气候法案；而且打造智能体虽门槛降低，但传统工业产线绝不敢将生产级调度权交付给不可解释的黑盒模型。
perspective_con.point_en: Rapid modular builds run headfirst into EU environmental mandates; furthermore, mission-critical manufacturing workflows cannot tolerate opaque AI agent errors.

linked_news.title_zh: 英伟达发布了DSX POD，这是其Vera Rubin参考架构的模块化容器化版本，可以将数据中心部署从6个月缩短到14天。
linked_news.title_en: Nvidia unveils the DSX POD, a modular containerized version of its Vera Rubin reference architecture to cut data center deployment from six months to 14 days (Charlotte Trueman/DatacenterDynamics)

linked_news.title_zh: 算力中心扩张受阻欧洲减排法规
linked_news.title_en: Europe Wants Data Centers. Its Climate Goals Are Getting in the Way

topics.title_zh: Anthropic用自研Claude从头逆向蝎毒蛋白，大厂激战湿实验室制药闭环
topics.title_en: Anthropic Unveils De Novo Claude Minibinders for Scorpion Toxins as Big Tech Invades Wet Labs
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic联手Citrini使用内部Claude模型针对5种致命蝎毒自主生成211种抗毒微结合蛋白并通过湿实验验证；与哈萨比斯预言AGI两至三年临界点及OpenAI接连收购生物智能体企业形成共振，开启科学发现大竞速。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic and Citrini deployed internal Claude models to generate 211 protein minibinders targeting lethal scorpion neurotoxins with wet-lab validation, aligning with Hassabis' shortened 2-3 year AGI horizon and OpenAI's biomedical M&A wave.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 大模型已跨越单纯语言预测，具备直接解构复杂生物物理折叠的通识逻辑，有望将动辄十年的靶向药物研发与湿实验测试周期压缩至数周。
perspective_pro.point_en: Foundation models have expanded beyond linguistic synthesis into biophysical ground truth, compressing multi-year drug discovery timelines into weeks.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 临床转化与生化理性派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 传统药理学家与生物伦理安全学者
perspective_con.point_zh: 体外微摩尔级结合与真实的体内跨膜靶向、毒代动力学和临床获批存在巨大鸿沟，大厂借此炒作AGI概念难掩早期高通量筛选的高昂脱靶风险。
perspective_con.point_en: In vitro binding affinity is miles away from in vivo bioavailability and FDA approval; touting AGI off synthetic screening overlooks severe off-target perils.

linked_news.title_zh: Demis Hassabis表示，他预计AGI将在两到三年内实现，低于他在2026年早些时候的三到五年预测，并讨论了AI的科学潜力
linked_news.title_en: Demis Hassabis says he expects AGI within two to three years, down from his three-to-five-year prediction earlier in 2026, and discusses AI's science potential (Ben Cohen/Wall Street Journal)

linked_news.title_zh: Anthropic和Citrini研究使用内部克劳德模型自主生成蛋白质微型粘合剂，针对五种蝎子神经毒素，测试了211种设计（Anthropic）
linked_news.title_en: Anthropic and Citrini Research use an internal Claude model to autonomously generate protein minibinders against five scorpion neurotoxins, testing 211 designs (Anthropic)

linked_news.title_zh: 大模型从头设计抗蝎毒结合蛋白
linked_news.title_en: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch

topics.title_zh: 美土安部下令拔除DeepSeek遭中方反制，OpenAI全量铺开三朵云抢食企业级市场
topics.title_en: China Pledges Countermeasures Over US DeepSeek Ban as OpenAI Expands to Google Cloud Ecosystem
topics.summary_zh: 美国国土安全部封杀DeepSeek并指控非法模型蒸馏，引发中方誓言坚决反制；与此同时，OpenAI正式宣布数周内全面上线谷歌云Model Garden与编码工具，完成对微软、AWS与谷歌三大云巨头的合围，加速收割全球企业客户。
topics.summary_en: China vowed resolute countermeasures against the US DHS ban on DeepSeek over distillation allegations, as OpenAI announced full deployment across Google Cloud's Model Garden, solidifying its enterprise distribution across all three hyperscalers.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 云生态中立与商业霸权派
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: OpenAI 商业化团队与企业IT架构决策层
perspective_pro.speaker_en: OpenAI Go-to-Market Team & Enterprise IT Decision Makers
perspective_pro.point_zh: 打通三朵主流公有云抹平了企业采购摩擦，合规且经过严格安全对齐的闭源前沿模型是跨国企业避免地缘合规风暴和模型供应链中断的唯一避风港。
perspective_pro.point_en: Tapping all major hyperscalers eliminates procurement friction, providing enterprises with a compliant, geopolitically secure alternative to contested open models.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 开源反封锁与主权对冲派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 开源安全社区与多极技术主张者
perspective_con.speaker_en: Open Source Community & Technology Sovereignty Advocates
perspective_con.point_zh: 以“模型蒸馏”为借口的行政禁令暴露出技术霸权的虚伪，大厂全渠道捆绑高昂订阅费只会迫使全球开发者更加坚定地拥抱低成本去中心化开源基座。
perspective_con.point_en: State-level bans based on vague distillation claims expose geopolitical paranoia, only accelerating developer migration toward cheap, uncensored open models.

linked_news.title_zh: OpenAI表示，它将在未来几周内在b谷歌Cloud的模型花园和反重力编码工具上提供其人工智能模型，该模型将于4月份在AWS上推出。
linked_news.title_en: OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April (Jordan Novet/CNBC)

linked_news.title_zh: 中国批评美国国土安全部的DeepSeek禁令，誓言“坚决反制”，同时否认联邦调查局和人工智能实验室非法蒸馏的指控
linked_news.title_en: China criticizes the US DHS's DeepSeek ban, vowing "resolute countermeasures" while rejecting allegations from the FBI and AI labs of illicit distillation (Ephrat Livni/New York Times)
